stats.source: GOB 517 adds learned-rank Weapon Crafting 655. crafting_server.py GetAbilityBonusByCategory covers the IW group.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives calculates and clears the skill. CraftingHandler.Specialization selects the corresponding stat for the physical weapon category.
stats.test: AbilityPassiveTests.WeaponMakerFeedsTheWeaponCategoryCompileContest checks the shipped revolver against an IT tool, an actual contest, and unload. ability-parity-coder-utility checks +50 at login.

stats.source: GOB 608 provides two function-2 bonuses at scale 0.1, linked to melee and ballistic damage.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives supplies typed stats 1142/1139. AbilityStats.Influence reads them from melee/ballistic callers and clears them on unload.
stats.test: AbilityPassiveTests.CodeHardeningAffectsOnlyMeleeAndBallisticDamageWhileLoaded checks exact typed damage, viral exclusion and unload. ability-parity-coder-utility observes both +5 startup records.

stats.source: GOB 609 stores one ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation update every five seconds and an independent initial ApplyAuraEffect callback.
stats.runtime: CoderPets starts the aura and next upkeep deadline together. The activation uses ordinary ability cost, and the timer uses exact 5 IS upkeep.
stats.test: ability-parity-coder-utility checks the 699 pet FX from a complete self-ability request, reads 10 then 5 IS debits, checks the initial wait and verifies that toggle-off stops upkeep.

pets.source: GOB 611 and simulacra.py supply Nuker level 34 for a level-50 caster, an eight-second cast, and the ordinary owned summon window.
pets.runtime: CoderPets.Land and SpawnFor create the actual pet and the 81 76 registration. Deactivate removes the current owned pet.
pets.test: ability-parity-coder-utility checks role, level, owner, real cast bar, 10 s timer, registration and 81 77 window removal.

stats.source: GOB 613 and 1108 both use self selector 0 and class buff family 37. Their respective Max Health and Melee Defense values are +100/+3 and +150/+6, with +20 melee and ballistic resistance on each.
stats.runtime: AbilitySupport casts on self. AbilityBuffs applies the same-family replacement, and AbilityStats and the vital recalculation path consume the current values.
stats.test: AbilityPassiveTests.UtilityMasterReplacesTechnicianAndFeedsAllFourSelfBuffStats checks exact active values, self selection, preserved current HP, replacement and cleanup. ability-parity-coder-utility verifies the complete real requests, wire adds and removal and both own reuse timers.

stats.source: GOB 620 grants child 1108 and gives +5 Melee Accuracy Bonus stat 997 while enabled.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives feeds stat 997 to melee accuracy and adds/removes the active child with its parent. The child cast checks loaded authority.

stats.source: GOB 699 uses caster-level function 3 at scale 0.5 in Viral Damage 172 and Healing 174 for five seconds.
stats.runtime: CoderPets applies both typed influences to the Nuker and Healer paths while the snapshot is active.

stats.source: GOB 700 uses caster-level function 3 at scale 1.3 for all three accuracy scores for five seconds.
stats.runtime: CoderPets raises the real pet hit chance by the exact shared value while active; the base curve and friendly area admission are separate checks.
stats.test: CoderPetTests.Daemon699AndPower25UseIndependentTimersAndCorrectDamageTypes and coder-pet-resources verify the rank-50 +64 input, lifetime, actual attack and toggle removal.
